groups.name: Terms of Service page
groups.about: The page at /terms. Leave a box empty to use the standard text shown under it. In the document, start each section with a line beginning ## and its title (### gives a smaller heading inside a section). Every other line is a paragraph; a line beginning - is a bullet point, and one beginning 1. is numbered. Put ** on both sides of words to make them bold, and write a link as [the words](https://address) or [the words](/privacy). An email or web address becomes a link by itself, and {email} becomes the email address from Contact above. Change the date whenever the wording changes: it is shown at the top of the page and tells search engines the page changed.

items: What our forms collect, why we ask for it, where it is kept, and how to have it removed.
Date the wording last changed (year-month-day, like 2026-11-06)

## What we collect
We only collect what you type into one of our forms:
- **The contact page and the order form on the Services page** ask for your name, email address, phone number, country and your message. With it we record the page you sent it from and your browser's user agent (the name and version of your browser and operating system).
- **The “work with us” form on the blog** asks for your name, phone number and the kind of project you're interested in.
This website sets no cookies, and we use no analytics, advertising or tracking tools.

## How we use it
We use your details to read your enquiry and get back to you about it. A message from the contact page or the Services page is saved in our database and emailed to our team, and a copy is emailed to you to confirm that it arrived.
We don't sell your details, share them for marketing, or add you to a mailing list.

## Services we use
The site runs on a few outside services, which handle your details only to run it for us:
- **Vercel** hosts this website, and **Render** runs the system that receives the forms.
- **Neon** hosts the database where messages are saved.
- **Cloudinary** stores and serves the images on the site.
- **An email service** delivers the emails described above.
- **Google Fonts** supplies the site's icons, so your browser asks Google's servers for them and Google sees your IP address.
Links to Google Maps, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube take you to those sites, and their own privacy policies apply there.

## Your choices
To see, correct or delete what you've sent us, email {email}.

## Changes to this policy
When this policy changes, we'll update this page and the date at the top.

## Data Protection
At IN-TA Solutions, we prioritize the security of your data. We employ industry-standard encryption and security protocols to ensure that your information remains confidential and protected against unauthorized access.

## Secure Infrastructure
Our infrastructure is built on world-class cloud providers with robust security measures. We regularly perform security audits and vulnerability assessments to maintain the highest standards of safety.

## Compliance
We adhere to global data protection regulations and standards. Our team is committed to ensuring compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant privacy laws.

## Report a Vulnerability
If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in our systems, please report it to us immediately at {email}.
